Location: Croatia, Dubrovnik / Europe Remote: Yes, remote-first or fully remote only Willing to relocate: No, remote preferred Technologies: TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Supabase, MongoDB, REST APIs, Stripe, OAuth, JWT, Docker, Vercel, Jest, Vitest, Cypress, Tailwind CSS Résumé/CV: https://personal-website-tau-sandy.vercel.app/Resume.pdf Email: lazarbukejlovic@icloud.com

Full-Stack Engineer with 3+ years of experience building production-ready React/TypeScript systems for SaaS, fintech, AI workflow, and data-heavy products.

I’m strongest in frontend-focused full-stack work: polished React/Next.js product interfaces, dashboards, auth flows, protected routes, API integrations, database-backed features, Stripe billing, deployment, QA, and debugging the production issues behind the UI.

Recent projects include MindPad AI, Flowstate, AtlasBrief, GeoRisk, and EchoRoom. These are not basic portfolio clones — they include real auth, payments, persistence, AI-assisted workflows, dashboards, billing logic, team flows, and deployed production-style architecture.

I’m looking for remote Frontend Engineer, Full-Stack Engineer, React Engineer, or Software Engineer roles where I can own real product work end-to-end and contribute quickly.
